name: Data, HUD & AI Processing
when_to_use: AI generating or an agent working through steps, progress bars and % counters, dashboards and data viz building, futuristic HUD overlays, 'the AI is analyzing' moments, code or terminal scrolling.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 01
sounds.desc: A 1.4 s run of digital data chatter that resolves into a confirmation blip near the end; ideal when an AI finishes generating or a render completes.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 02
sounds.desc: A 0.75 s mid-toned data sequence that builds up into a firm confirmation hit; great when an AI result or stat appears on screen.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 03
sounds.desc: Tonal data sequence that builds for almost a second into a clear peak and resolves with a clean tail; ideal for an AI finishing its answer or a render completing.

sounds.name: Data Read Burble 01
sounds.desc: A soft, mid-toned 7-second data burble with steady level and matching edges; a clean bed for AI-thinking or loading moments.

sounds.name: Data Read Chatter 01
sounds.desc: A 3.8-second steady data chatter with matched edges and balanced brightness; a go-to short loop under AI processing or a % counter.

sounds.name: Data Glitch Blip 01
sounds.desc: A 120 ms digital blip that swells into its cut; use for a HUD element appearing.

sounds.name: Data Glitch Blip 02
sounds.desc: A 100 ms digital blip with a little low body; use for HUD elements or readout beeps.

sounds.name: Data Glitch Blip 03
sounds.desc: A mid-range, fairly tonal 105 ms digital beep; use for readouts or a button confirming.

sounds.name: Data Glitch Blip 04
sounds.desc: A 133 ms digital blip that builds to its cut; use for a target lock or element appearing.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 04
sounds.desc: The longest of the set, a 1.8 s data sequence that works up to a confirmation at about 1.6 s; use under a progress bar or % counter hitting 100.

sounds.name: Data Read Burble 02
sounds.desc: A punchy 1.8-second data burble with a solid low end; use when a data visual snaps together or an AI result is being computed.

sounds.name: Data Read Burst 01
sounds.desc: Bright data-reading burst of about 1.3 seconds that swells mid-way; use for an AI step processing or a scan across a screenshot.

sounds.name: Data Read Burst 02
sounds.desc: Punchy 0.6-second data-read blip that hits up front and thins out; good for a HUD panel or stat card snapping on.

sounds.name: Data Read Burst 03
sounds.desc: Loud, bright computer read chatter just over a second with an immediate start; use for a fast scan or data populating a dashboard.

sounds.name: Data Read Chatter 02
sounds.desc: Busy 6.5-second digital readout chatter with a steady texture; loop it under a progress bar or an 'the AI is analyzing' moment.

sounds.name: Data Read Chatter 03
sounds.desc: Nearly 10 seconds of even, bright data chatter with matched edges; a background loop for terminal scrolling or an agent at work.

sounds.name: Data Scrub Loop 01
sounds.desc: Bright, harsh data-scrubbing chatter looping for about 10.6 seconds; use under AI processing, code scrolling or a corrupted dashboard.

sounds.name: Deep Process Complete 01
sounds.desc: Darker, tonal low-mid processing sequence that swells toward a late peak and decays cleanly; use for a weightier 'analysis complete' beat.

sounds.name: HUD Readout Beep 01
sounds.desc: A steady mid-pitched 110 ms tonal beep; suits a HUD panel or data readout appearing.

sounds.name: Low Telemetry Pulse 01
sounds.desc: Loud, pure low tonal readout pulse about 0.7 seconds long that decays quickly; use as a heavy HUD confirm or a stat-landing accent.

sounds.name: Melodic Data Readout 01
sounds.desc: About 9 seconds of melodic data readings with repeating rising tones, for an AI working through steps or a dashboard building up.

sounds.name: Router Data Chatter 01
sounds.desc: Bright, steady electromagnetic data chatter picked up from an internet router, a seamless loop that reads as data flowing; sit it under AI generating, progress bars or code scrolling.

sounds.name: Tablet Data Chatter 01
sounds.desc: An 11-second iPad electromagnetic sequence of dense digital burbling and interference, a strong processing texture for AI or data-viz moments.

sounds.name: Telemetry Readout Loop 01
sounds.desc: Bright, busy computer readout loop of about 2.5 seconds with level edges; loop it under a progress bar or an AI thinking moment.

sounds.name: Telemetry Readout Loop 02
sounds.desc: Tonal beeping computer readout cycle of about 1.3 seconds with level edges for looping; use under a progress counter or HUD overlay.

sounds.name: Telemetry Readout Loop 03
sounds.desc: Loud, bright and busy readout cycle around 1.3 seconds that loops; drive a fast data-processing or code-scroll shot.

sounds.name: Tonal Telemetry Beep 01
sounds.desc: Short tonal computer beep sequence under a second with a clean tail; use when a HUD panel or readout appears.

sounds.name: Tonal Telemetry Beep 02
sounds.desc: Half-second bright tonal readout chirp that swells in and ends cleanly; use for a HUD element or data label appearing.

sounds.name: Data Read Burst 04
sounds.desc: Tonal data-reading sequence of about 1.5 seconds that grows and cuts off at its loudest; hard-cut out of it into a reveal.

sounds.name: Hard Drive Screech Loop 01
sounds.desc: A noisier, grinding 20-second hard-drive screech loop, for heavy data crunching or a machine working too hard.

sounds.name: Data Glitch Blip 05
sounds.desc: A bright 110 ms digital blip; use for AI agent step ticks or dashboard elements appearing.

sounds.name: Data Glitch Blip 06
sounds.desc: A steady 110 ms bright digital blip; use for data readouts appearing on screen.

sounds.name: Data Glitch Blip 07
sounds.desc: A slightly noisy 110 ms databent blip; use for HUD panels or code lines appearing.

sounds.name: Data Glitch Blip 08
sounds.desc: An 80 ms noisy digital blip with an instant attack; use for data points landing on a chart.

sounds.name: Data Glitch Blip 09
sounds.desc: A gritty 140 ms digital blip; use for AI processing steps or terminal output lines.

sounds.name: Data Glitch Blip 10
sounds.desc: A 90 ms digital blip with a touch of low-end thump; use for a data card or panel landing.

sounds.name: Data Glitch Blip 11
sounds.desc: A 145 ms digital beep that decays quickly; use for telemetry or step-complete ticks.

sounds.name: Data Glitch Blip 12
sounds.desc: A noisy 80 ms data blip; use for scanning steps or HUD overlays.

sounds.name: Data Glitch Blip 13
sounds.desc: A grainy 120 ms digital blip; use for AI 'thinking' steps or data populating a dashboard.

sounds.name: Data Glitch Blip 14
sounds.desc: A mid-range 100 ms tonal digital beep; use when dashboard elements appear.

sounds.name: Data Glitch Blip 15
sounds.desc: A 110 ms digital blip with an instant onset; use for HUD labels or data viz points.

sounds.name: Data Glitch Blip 16
sounds.desc: A 160 ms digital blip with a soft decay; use when a HUD panel or agent step appears.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 05
sounds.desc: A loud, bright 0.6 s burst of chattering data that ends on a hard digital stop; use as an AI agent finishes a quick step.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 06
sounds.desc: A 0.85 s bright, noisy data sequence peaking into a confirmation near the end; use as a progress step finishes or a dashboard panel resolves.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 07
sounds.desc: A short 0.4 s bright burst of data chatter; use under a quick HUD element appearing or a fast processing step.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 08
sounds.desc: A 1 s bright digital processing sequence with a mid-way peak; good under an agent working through a step or a chart building.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 09
sounds.desc: A 1.4 s data sequence that opens on its strongest hit and chatters out; use when a process kicks off or code starts scrolling.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 10
sounds.desc: A 0.6 s digital processing blip sequence with an early peak and a tidy fade; good for a progress step ticking off or a HUD readout.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 11
sounds.desc: A 1.4 s bright data run that builds and ends right on its loudest blip; back-time it so the final hit lands on a result or task-complete moment.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 12
sounds.desc: Mid-bright digital data chatter that builds for half a second into a confirming peak, then settles; use when an AI agent finishes a step or a dashboard finishes loading.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 13
sounds.desc: Bright, hissy burst of computer chatter with a quick attack and a fairly abrupt stop; use for an agent completing a task or a terminal finishing a run.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 14
sounds.desc: Short data sequence that climbs steadily and cuts off at its loudest point; place it so the cut lands on a result or stat appearing.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 15
sounds.desc: Very bright, sizzling data chatter that hits immediately and fades out cleanly over about a second; use under a quick AI analysis or code-scroll moment.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 16
sounds.desc: Longer 2.7-second run of bright, hissy computer processing that peaks near the end before stopping; use under a progress bar or an agent working through steps.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 17
sounds.desc: Tonal digital blip sequence with some low-end weight that peaks early and runs under a second; use as a compact 'processing done' confirmation.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 18
sounds.desc: Tonal, slightly weighty data sequence that starts strong and runs for 1.5 seconds; use when a dashboard or AI output finishes generating.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 19
sounds.desc: Bright-mid data chatter that ramps up to its loudest moment right at the end; line the end up with a number or card landing.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 20
sounds.desc: Loud, bright and noisy computer chatter about a second long with a hard stop; use for a punchy 'task done' in a fast agent demo.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 21
sounds.desc: Bright digital chatter that peaks almost instantly and trails off within a second; use for small step-complete moments in an agent workflow.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 22
sounds.desc: Bright, crisp data sequence with an early hit and a short decaying tail; use for HUD elements confirming or a checklist step finishing.

sounds.name: Data Process Complete 23
sounds.desc: Short, bright tonal data sequence under 0.7 seconds that peaks past the middle; a compact confirmation for an AI step or a data card appearing.

sounds.name: Data Read Burble 03

sounds.name: Data Read Burble 04
